name: Pressure Cooker Pot Roast
subtitle: Tender beef with potatoes, onions, and rich gravy
description: Browned beef cooks under pressure with onion seasoning, then shares the pot with potatoes and onions. The cooking liquid becomes a simple gravy.

ingredients.item: salt and ground black pepper to taste

instructions.text: Season the roast with salt and black pepper, then coat it with the flour; reserve the remaining flour for the gravy.
Heat the shortening in the pressure cooker. Add the roast and brown it on all sides.
Stir the onion soup mix into 2.5 cups cold water, or enough as needed, and add the mixture to the cooker.

Secure the lid and cook under pressure for 120 minutes. Release pressure according to the cooker instructions, then verify that the roast is tender and reaches 145°F in the center. Rest it for at least 3 minutes.
Transfer the roast to a platter. Add the potatoes and peeled onions to the cooker, bring the cooker back to pressure, and cook for 10 minutes.
Transfer the vegetables to the platter. Bring the cooking liquid to a simmer.
Whisk the reserved flour with 0.5 cup cold water until smooth. Whisk it into the simmering liquid, bring the gravy to a boil, and cook until thickened, about 3 minutes.
Slice the roast and serve with the vegetables and gravy.
